evidence.observed: Anonymous GET learning session returns 200 and child/score data.
Child A token receives child B session; session ownership is not checked.
Anonymous lesson?childId=B exposes that child completion, stars and score.
Teacher receives another child progress through /children; no class scope query occurs.
Stage 3 writes completed=true for an inactive other-age lesson with no stages 1/2, game result or unit grant.
Identical stage 2 request submitted twice adds 50+50 points; no operation ID deduplication.
A one-question activity worth 10 attempts to store score=50 when the same question index is repeated five times.
No answers still reaches ActivityResult.create with completed=true.
Vocabulary is physically deleted after pulling only Lesson.vocabularyItems; no activity/mastery/language/progress dependency check.
Public registration with a password and no PIN saves default PIN 1234, enabling an alternate weak login path.
Child session can write senderRole=PARENT with a supplied name and no adult identity verification.
A child-owner callable debug route saves a fabricated 30-day streak and activity dates.
PIN change also changes password but does not increment authVersion; prior JWT remains accepted.
Configured URI failure is followed by a successful local database fallback without explicit opt-in.
An assignment with two snapshotted activities is marked submitted after only one when the other activity is no longer ACTIVE.
